body: This is a haunting and atmospheric sci-fi story that feels both intimate and enormous. The world of Mairee is beautiful, dangerous, and deeply alive, with writing that pulls you into its mystery from the start. A great read for anyone who likes thoughtful, visceral science fiction that stays with you after finishing.

Initially it was the cover of THE UNFOLDING: MAIREE that drew me in, it was so captivating that I couldn’t help but read the blurb on the back. I am a big fan of BTG and I dabbled in Lost, so this book appealed to me on a few different levels and I’m happy to say that I wasn’t disappointed. There were even a few Resident Evil vibes with the biological horror aspect of the book, something that really resonated with someone like me who was very much into the franchise.
  I do love a good mystery, and this one certainly had me hooked, I had to keep turning the pages following that trail all the way to the end of the book which is no mean feat by the author. Usually, I’m the person who guesses the twists but this certainly kept me on my toes.
  The world building was wonderful, and it certainly makes or breaks a sci-fi book. I had no problem believing that I was actually stepping through the pages and into this wonderful and immersive world the author created.
  I would certainly say if you’re looking for something a little bit different from the sci-fi genre this is definitely the book for you.
